buildCommand: cd .. && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir app-preview/dist
ignoreCommand: cd .. && if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- app src assets package.json package-lock.json app.json babel.config.js metro.config.js app-preview; else exit 1; fi
